ethnicity_note: Residents by nationality in the Central Administration of Statistics' Labour Force and Household Living Conditions Survey 2018-2019 (Table HL.6A), weighted to mid-2018 population estimates: an estimated 31,738 Lebanese and 2,104 non-Lebanese residents. Non-Lebanese is everyone without Lebanese citizenship, whatever their nationality, the stateless included. The survey covers residential dwellings only: refugee camps and their adjacent gatherings, informal settlements, army barracks and work sites are left out, so the Palestinians, Syrians and migrant workers living there are not in these figures. CAS publishes no sample size per caza; each caza is one of the design's 26 strata, allocated at least 68 of its about 2,700 sample ilots (a few slightly fewer after fieldwork). Lebanon has held no census since 1932. Nationality, not ethnicity: the survey tabulates nationality and no ethnic or confessional group, so nationality is shown here in place of ethnicity; 'Lebanese' is every Lebanese citizen, of whatever community. Low precision: CAS marks estimates under 2,500 residents, as the non-Lebanese one is here, as having a relative standard error above 20%.
